A record section is verified by opening the files it cites; open lane files from `$C` by path and list each in `inputs` with its sha256 (sha256sum). Files the L1 appends after this wave (SCORECARD.md, LOG.md, SHONEN.md, corpus/lessons/round-17.md, anything under .ufo/waves/) must be read only as `git -C $C show 2a22adeb7d1de5e7189e62ce41ac679d71a97b44:<path>` and listed in `external_inputs` as `tameshi@2a22adeb7d1de5e7189e62ce41ac679d71a97b44:<path>`. Sibling-repo reads go in `external_inputs` too. Do not list SKILL.md as an input.
- End your report with exactly one fenced ```json block (schema tameshi-coldread-report-v2): {"schema":"tameshi-coldread-report-v2","seat":"<YourName>","skill_sha256":"de6c2b083be6f35d2c35e011ca37874f57204a2cdd195a106ff638fbea723dbc","read_rev":"2a22adeb7d1de5e7189e62ce41ac679d71a97b44","sections":[{"start":<heading line>,"heading":"<exact heading line, \"\" for the preamble>","class":"instruction|record","verdict":"executed-ok|verified-record|gap-minor|gap-blocking|wrong-expectation|not-executed","blocking_gaps":[..],"wrong_expectations":[..],"minor_gaps":[..],"commands_executed":[..],"opened":[..],"inputs":{"<lane-relative path>":"<sha256>"},"external_inputs":{"<abs path or repo@rev:path>":"<sha256>"},"traces":["<lane-relative receipt path>"]}]}. Definitions: instruction = the section tells a reader to do something (run, check, write, decide); record = it reports what happened. executed-ok = you executed every instruction and got the stated outcome; verified-record = every checkable record claim checked and true; gap-minor = holds with non-blocking gaps; gap-blocking = a reader cannot complete it from the page; wrong-expectation = a stated outcome is false at 2a22adeb7d1de5e7189e62ce41ac679d71a97b44; not-executed = you could not run it (say why). Every entry must have non-empty `inputs`; every entry with commands must list its receipts in `traces`.
